description: Implementation of the ReuseAllocatorBase class managing memory blocks, including allocation, freeing, merging, and printing allocation info.

classes.name: ReuseAllocatorBase
classes.description: Memory allocator class managing free and allocated memory blocks with merging and printing capabilities.

classes.name: MemoryBlock
classes.description: Represents a block of memory with methods for merging, allocation, and fulfillment checks.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges two adjacent memory blocks if they are contiguous.

methods.name: CanFulfill
methods.description: Checks if the memory block can fulfill a request of a given size and alignment.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates a portion of the memory block with specified size and alignment.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory with specified size and alignment, returning a pointer.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated memory block.

methods.name: PrintAllocations
methods.description: Prints current allocations and free blocks statistics.

methods.name: TryFree
methods.description: Attempts to free a memory block given its pointer.

methods.name: ExpandToFit
methods.description: Expands memory capacity to fit a requested size and alignment.

methods.name: AddAllocatedBlock
methods.description: Adds a block to the allocated blocks map.

methods.name: AddFreeBlock
methods.description: Adds a free block, merging with adjacent free blocks if possible.

methods.name: RemoveFreeBlock
methods.description: Removes a free block from the free list.
